title: The Only Droid
description:
ㅤ

CAN YOU SURVIVE?

Tear enemies apart piece by piece in this physics-based action roguelite, where enemies are a combination of moving parts and exposed weaknesses. Stack upgrades, pick up loot, and adapt your build on the fly as the difficulty increases.

ㅤ

TARGET WEAK POINTS

Enemies are not just bullet sponges. Target their limbs, destroy their components, and use their exposed weak points to take them down in fast-paced combat.

ㅤ

TEST YOUR BUILD

Customize your build before each run, then find new upgrades in the midst of battle. Build up powerful combinations, and create builds that make you a lightning-fast glass cannon, an unstoppable tank, or something completely broken.

ㅤ

Discover New Gear

All items start undiscovered. Find them during your runs, and once revealed, they become permanently available to purchase and use in future loadouts.

ㅤ

• 50+ unique items that create endless synergies and builds.

• loadout menu to customize your build.

• 5 different worlds to fight through.

• unique bosses at the end of each stage.

• multi-part minibosses that spawn across the map.

• 15+ weapons

• physics-based combat

ㅤ
description_short: Tear enemy robots apart piece by piece in a physics-based action roguelike. Destroy weak points, stack upgrades, and create your unique build as you turn relentless robotic enemy waves into mechanical graveyards.
